Question: Let \(S\) be the set of lattice points in the coordinate plane, both of whose coordinates are integers between \(1\) and \(30,\) inclusive. Exactly \(300\) points in \(S\) lie on or below a line with equation \(y=mx.\) The possible values of \(m\) lie in an interval of length \(\dfrac{a}{b},\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are relatively prime positive integers. What is \(a+b?\)
